mri-scan.title: MRI-SCAN
mri-scan.content:
What is an MRI Scan?

An MRI Scan (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) provides incredibly detailed images of your internal organs and structures. Specifically, our expert radiologists utilize powerful magnetic fields and radio waves to create high-resolution, cross-sectional views of your body. Consequently, this non-invasive procedure helps doctors diagnose complex medical conditions with absolute precision. Therefore, prioritizing your diagnostic imaging ensures optimal healthcare outcomes and treatment planning.

The Medical Science Behind Magnetic Resonance Imaging

Unlike traditional X-rays or CT scans, an MRI scan completely avoids ionizing radiation. Furthermore, the machine utilizes a powerful superconducting magnet to temporarily align the hydrogen protons in your body. Next, precise radiofrequency pulses disrupt this alignment. As the protons return to their normal state, they emit distinct radio signals. Thus, our advanced computer systems translate these microscopic signals into highly detailed, 3D medical images. According to guidelines from the American College of Radiology (ACR), this provides unmatched clarity for soft tissue evaluation.

Comprehensive MRI Scan Types

We offer specialized imaging protocols tailored to evaluate specific anatomical regions with diagnostic excellence.

  • MRI Brain Scan: Assesses the brain and brainstem for tumors, strokes, multiple sclerosis, or aneurysms.
  • MRI Spine Scan: Evaluates the cervical, thoracic, or lumbar spine. Specifically, it accurately detects disc herniation, spinal cord compression, or nerve damage.
  • Joint & Musculoskeletal MRI: Examines knees, shoulders, and hips for ligament tears, tendonitis, or joint degradation.
  • Abdomen & Pelvis MRI: Details internal organs like the liver, kidneys, pancreas, and reproductive system.
  • Whole Body MRI Scan: A comprehensive screening tool designed for proactive health monitoring and cancer metastasis detection.
  • MR Angiography (MRA): Specifically visualizes major blood vessels to detect blockages, narrowings, or aneurysms without invasive catheters.

We firmly believe that life-saving diagnostics should remain accessible. Thus, we structure our pricing to deliver premium medical technology without hidden fees.

Step-by-Step Patient Preparation and Prerequisites

Proper preparation ensures we capture pristine diagnostic images. Therefore, please carefully follow our clinical checklist prior to your appointment.

  • Metal Clearance: You must remove all metallic objects, including jewelry, watches, hairpins, and hearing aids. The MRI magnet is always on.
  • Medical History: Inform our staff immediately if you have any internal metal implants, such as a pacemaker, cochlear implant, aneurysm clips, or artificial joints.
  • Clothing: Wear comfortable, metal-free clothing. Alternatively, you will be provided with a secure medical gown to wear during the procedure.
  • Clearance Reports: Always bring your doctor’s referral prescription and any previous medical imaging or surgery reports.

Fasting and Contrast Injection Conditions

For a standard, non-contrast scan, fasting is rarely required. You may eat and drink normally. However, if your physician orders a contrast-enhanced MRI, you must adhere strictly to specific fasting guidelines. Specifically, you need to fast for 4 to 6 hours before the procedure. You may drink plain water, but you must avoid all solid foods and milk products.

Furthermore, before we administer the Gadolinium-based contrast dye, we require a recent serum creatinine blood test. Consequently, this ensures your kidneys are functioning properly to clear the contrast agent safely from your body.

What to Expect During the Procedure

Our certified technologists execute the MRI scan with profound respect for your safety and physical comfort.

  1. Positioning: Our technologist gently positions you on a motorized sliding table.
  2. Coil Placement: We place specialized receiver coils around the specific body part being scanned to amplify the image signals.
  3. The Scan: The table slides smoothly into the cylindrical magnet. The machine produces loud tapping and thumping noises. Therefore, we provide sterile earplugs or comfortable headphones playing music.
  4. Communication: You can easily communicate with our technologist at any time via a two-way intercom system. You must remain completely still during image capture to avoid blurring.

The entire procedure typically lasts between 20 and 45 minutes, depending on the complexity of the scan.

Advanced Medical Technology: Machines and Models

We heavily invest in cutting-edge diagnostic hardware. For example, we utilize advanced 1.5 Tesla and 3.0 Tesla MRI systems. These industry-leading models provide unparalleled high-resolution imaging capabilities. Moreover, our latest equipment features wider bores (openings) and noise-reduction technology. Thus, we significantly reduce feelings of claustrophobia and ensure maximum patient comfort without compromising clinical accuracy.

Diagnostic Reporting and Hardcopy Availability

We completely understand that waiting for medical results causes immense anxiety. Therefore, our expert radiologists evaluate your scans immediately.

  • Instant WhatsApp Reporting: Receive your secure, digital PDF diagnostic report directly to your smartphone the moment it is finalized.
  • Fast Turn-Around Time: We guarantee a highly efficient 24-hour turn-around time, with most critical reports delivered on the exact same day.
  • Hardcopy Films & Media: High-resolution physical diagnostic films and smart-CDs remain readily available at our reception desk for your primary physician’s clinical review.

Why Choose Us for Your Care?

Our diagnostic center stands out by combining world-class medical technology with deeply compassionate patient care.

  • Expert Radiologists: Our board-certified imaging specialists possess decades of experience in complex pathology detection and neuroimaging.
  • Dedicated Technicians: Our highly trained technicians focus entirely on your physical comfort, safety, and anxiety management during the procedure.
  • Seamless Booking Process: You can quickly secure an appointment via our website form, a direct phone call, or our instant WhatsApp booking line, ensuring zero wait times.

mammography.title: Mammography
mammography.content:
What is Digital Mammography?

If you are exploring preventative health checkups, you might wonder about the importance of breast imaging. Digital mammography is a specialized, low-dose X-ray examination of the breasts. Specifically, our highly trained experts utilize this advanced imaging technique to detect breast cancer and other microscopic abnormalities at the earliest possible stage.

Furthermore, early detection significantly improves treatment outcomes. Consequently, healthcare organizations strongly advocate for routine screening. At our facility, our team performs both screening and diagnostic mammography to ensure you receive the most accurate breast tissue evaluation available.

Why Choose Us For Breast Care?

We prioritize your health, comfort, and accurate reporting above all else.

  • Female Technologists: We understand the need for privacy. Therefore, experienced female technologists handle your scan with the utmost care.
  • Latest Technology: Moreover, we utilize advanced systems for superior, high-resolution breast imaging.
  • Quick Reporting: As a result of our efficient workflows, we deliver precise reports on the same day via WhatsApp and physical hardcopy.
  • Low Radiation: Similarly, our modern digital detectors require a significantly lower radiation dose compared to traditional film mammograms.

Types of Digital Mammography We Offer

Our facility provides comprehensive breast imaging solutions tailored to your specific clinical needs. For example, your physician may recommend a specific type based on your symptoms.

  • Screening Mammography: A routine examination for women who have no obvious signs or symptoms of breast cancer. Consequently, it helps identify microcalcifications early.
  • Diagnostic Mammography: Additionally, we perform diagnostic mammograms if a patient presents with a breast lump, pain, or nipple discharge. This requires more specialized views.
  • 3D Mammography (Tomosynthesis): Furthermore, digital breast tomosynthesis captures multiple thin image slices. Thus, it dramatically improves cancer detection in dense breast tissue.
  • Contrast-Enhanced (CEM): We administer an iodine-based contrast agent to highlight abnormal blood flow. As a result, we can accurately map complex breast masses.
  • Bilateral & Unilateral: Depending on your referral, our team conducts Bilateral Mammography (both breasts) or Unilateral Mammography (single breast evaluation).

Digital Mammography Price List

We believe in transparent and affordable pricing. Check our competitive diagnostic rates.

3D Mammography 4,500 3,200 Advanced 3D Slices + Radiologist Consultation + Hardcopy Film

Pre-Scan Guidelines & Prerequisites

Proper preparation ensures the highest quality imaging. Therefore, please adhere to these clinical guidelines:

  • Deodorant Restrictions: Do not apply deodorants, powders, lotions, or perfumes under your arms or on your breasts. These substances can appear as white spots on the X-ray.
  • Clothing Recommendations: Wear a comfortable, two-piece outfit. You will only need to remove your top.
  • Medical History: Bring all previous mammograms, breast ultrasounds, and physician referrals.
  • Pregnancy Status: Always inform your technologist if there is any possibility of pregnancy.

The Procedure: Step-by-Step

Our certified female technologists execute the digital mammography process with profound respect for your physical comfort.

  1. Check-in & Change: Our staff will welcome you. Subsequently, you will change into a comfortable medical gown in a private dressing room.
  2. Positioning: A specialized female technologist will position your breast on the imaging platform, thus ensuring accurate alignment.
  3. Gentle Compression: The machine gently compresses the breast for a few seconds. Consequently, this evens out the tissue and minimizes the radiation dose.
  4. Image Capture & Review: Our low-dose X-ray captures the images from multiple angles. Finally, the radiologist reviews the images for quality before you leave.

Advanced Breast Imaging & Scientific Context

Our expert radiologists utilize the internationally recognized BI-RADS classification (Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System). Consequently, this standardized system categorizes results from 0 to 6, providing clear guidance for your referring physician regarding follow-up steps.

Furthermore, evaluating Breast Density is a critical component of our reporting. Women with dense breasts have more fibrous and glandular tissue compared to fatty tissue. Therefore, we frequently recommend 3D Mammography (Digital Breast Tomosynthesis) or supplementary breast ultrasound, as dense tissue can obscure small tumors on standard 2D images.

Reporting Turn-Around Time

We respect your time and anxiety regarding test results. Therefore, our expert team processes your reports swiftly.

  • WhatsApp Reporting: Receive instant digital reports as soon as the radiologist signs off.
  • Same Day Delivery: Physical reports are consistently available within 24 hours.
  • Hardcopy Films: High-resolution physical films are provided for your clinical records.

anomaly-scan.title: anomaly-scan
anomaly-scan.content:
Understanding the Mid-Pregnancy Anomaly Scan

An Anomaly Scan, frequently referred to as a Level 2 Scan or mid-pregnancy ultrasound, represents one of the most critical diagnostic evaluations during pregnancy. Medical professionals perform this detailed anatomical survey strictly between 18 and 22 weeks of gestation. Specifically, this ultrasound allows our fetal medicine specialists to examine every major organ system of your developing baby. Consequently, we ensure your baby is growing appropriately and screen for any structural abnormalities.

The Clinical Importance of the 20-Week Scan

While an early screening assesses chromosomal risks during the first trimester, the Anomaly Scan provides a comprehensive physical examination. Furthermore, by 20 weeks, the fetal organs are large enough for highly detailed visualization. Therefore, this evaluation gives expectant parents profound reassurance regarding the baby’s structural health.

What Do We Examine During the Procedure?

Our expert sonographers conduct a systematic, head-to-toe evaluation of the fetus. Specifically, we follow international ISUOG guidelines to assess the following crucial anatomical structures:

  • Fetal Brain & Head: We measure the brain’s ventricles and ensure proper skull formation.
  • Fetal Face: We check for a cleft lip and evaluate the nasal bone and eye placement.
  • Fetal Heart: Our specialists perform a detailed cardiac evaluation to check the four chambers, major blood vessels, and heart rhythm.
  • Spine & Abdomen: We meticulously examine the spinal column, stomach, kidneys, and abdominal wall.
  • Limbs: We verify the presence and proper development of all four limbs, hands, and feet.
  • Maternal Health Markers: Additionally, we assess the position of the placenta, the volume of amniotic fluid, and the length of the cervix.

Advanced Fetal Imaging Technology

We utilize world-class, high-resolution ultrasound equipment to capture exceptional 3D and 4D fetal images. Furthermore, our certified radiologists operate advanced diagnostic hardware to detect subtle anatomical details with absolute clinical accuracy.

Moreover, ultrasound relies entirely on harmless sound waves. Thus, the procedure remains completely safe and non-invasive without exposing the mother or baby to radiation.

Step-by-Step Patient Preparation Guide

Proper preparation ensures we capture the clearest possible images of your baby. Therefore, we advise our patients to follow these simple pre-scan guidelines:

  • Fasting is not required: Please consume a normal, healthy meal before your appointment.
  • Hydration: Maintain normal hydration. A completely full bladder is usually not necessary at 20 weeks, but a moderately filled bladder can help optimize image clarity.
  • Medical Records: Always bring your prior ultrasound reports, including your first-trimester screening data.
  • Clothing: Wear comfortable, two-piece clothing for easy access to your abdomen.

Unmatched Precision and Patient Care

We understand that a mid-pregnancy scan can induce anxiety. Therefore, our team prioritizes compassionate care alongside medical excellence. We generate highly accurate digital reports quickly. Furthermore, if our specialists detect any atypical findings, we will guide you clearly and empathetically toward the necessary next steps or consultations.

nt-scan.title: nt-scan
nt-scan.content:
Comprehensive NT Scan: Advanced First Trimester Fetal Screening

Welcome to Henotic Diagnostics. An NT Scan (Nuchal Translucency Scan) represents a crucial milestone in your early pregnancy journey. Specifically, our expert fetal medicine specialists use this ultrasound to evaluate your baby’s development. As a result, we provide essential insights into chromosomal risks and early structural health. Therefore, choosing a specialized diagnostic center ensures complete maternal reassurance.

Understanding the Nuchal Translucency Assessment

Medical professionals perform this specialized evaluation strictly between 11 weeks and 13 weeks 6 days of pregnancy. During this specific window, the fetal crown-rump length falls exactly within the required range of 45mm to 84mm. Consequently, our sonographers can accurately measure the fluid accumulation at the back of the developing baby’s neck.

Scientific Principles of Fetal Imaging

Our radiologists utilize high-frequency sound waves to capture real-time images of the fetus. Furthermore, this advanced ultrasound technology operates without any harmful radiation. Thus, according to RadiologyInfo guidelines, the procedure remains completely safe for both the mother and the baby.

Chromosomal Abnormality Screening

The primary clinical goal involves evaluating genetic risks. For example, increased nuchal fluid often correlates with a higher risk for Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21), Edwards Syndrome (Trisomy 18), and Patau Syndrome (Trisomy 13). However, it is important to remember that this test provides a risk probability rather than a definitive diagnosis. Therefore, we often combine these findings with a Dual Marker Test to significantly boost screening sensitivity.

Comprehensive NT Scan Types

We tailor our prenatal screening strategies to match your specific medical history and maternal age-related risks. Specifically, our clinic offers several advanced variations of this crucial test.

  • Standard NT Scan: We strictly measure the nuchal fluid to calculate baseline genetic risks.
  • Scan with Nasal Bone Assessment: Our doctors verify the presence of the fetal nasal bone. Similarly, an absent nasal bone serves as an additional marker for chromosomal conditions.
  • First Trimester Screening Scan: We conduct a thorough anatomical check of early brain and limb development.
  • Scan with Dual Marker Correlation: We perfectly synchronize ultrasound metrics with maternal blood hormones.
  • Early Fetal Wellbeing Scan: We systematically assess the fetal heart rate, placenta location, and amniotic fluid volume.
  • First Trimester Genetic Screening: A focused review targeting patients with a family history of congenital conditions.
  • High-Risk Pregnancy Scan: We closely monitor mothers with pre-existing health challenges.
  • Detailed Doppler Assessment: Our specialists analyze maternal-fetal blood flow to predict preeclampsia risks early.
  • Multiple Pregnancy (Twin/Triplet) Scan: We evaluate chorionicity and individually assess each fetus for specific twin-related complications.
  • Early Fetal Anomaly Screening: We inspect early structural developments to complement the mid-pregnancy Anomaly Scan.

Transparent Pricing and Ultrasound Packages

We believe every expectant mother deserves accessible, premium healthcare. Therefore, we offer transparent pricing with high-value diagnostic inclusions.

Standard Assessment 2,500 2,000 Fluid measurement + Basic Anatomy + Same Day Report
Nasal Bone Package 3,000 2,400 Fluid + Nasal Bone + WhatsApp Digital Copy
High-Risk Screening 4,000 3,200 Detailed Doppler + Doctor Consult + Printed Report
Twin Pregnancy Scan 4,500 3,800 Dual Assessment + Chorionicity + Image Availability

Step-by-Step Procedure and Pre-Scan Guidelines

We prioritize your comfort throughout the entire clinical process. Furthermore, proper preparation ensures our specialists capture the highest quality fetal images.

Prerequisites and Preparations Checklist

Our team advises all expectant mothers to follow these straightforward pre-scan guidelines:

  • Pregnancy Timing: You must schedule the appointment exactly between 11 and 13.6 weeks.
  • Hydration: Maintain normal hydration. Specifically, a moderately filled bladder often helps position the uterus perfectly for imaging.
  • Fasting: You do not need to fast. Consequently, you should eat a normal, healthy meal before arriving.
  • Clothing: Wear comfortable, two-piece clothing to allow easy access to your abdomen.
  • Documentation: Always bring your doctor’s referral note, medical history, and previous early pregnancy reports.

How We Perform the Examination

First, you will lie comfortably on our examination bed. Next, our sonographer applies a warm, hypoallergenic acoustic gel to your lower abdomen. Then, they smoothly glide the ultrasound transducer across your skin. Occasionally, an internal transvaginal approach provides better clarity if the baby sits in a difficult position. The entire procedure generally takes between 20 and 40 minutes.

Comparing First Trimester Prenatal Tests

Expectant mothers often feel overwhelmed by prenatal testing options. Therefore, we follow ACOG recommendations to help you understand your choices clearly.

  • NT Assessment: Uses ultrasound to detect physical markers indicating genetic risks.
  • Dual Marker Test: Analyzes specific maternal blood hormones to supplement ultrasound findings.
  • NIPT Test: Examines cell-free fetal DNA in maternal blood for highly accurate chromosomal screening.
  • Anomaly Scan: A mid-pregnancy ultrasound performed later (18-22 weeks) to check every physical organ in detail.

Advanced Medical Technology and Equipment

Henotic Diagnostics heavily invests in AI-assisted fetal imaging software. As a result, our automated measurement tools reduce human error entirely.

High-Resolution Ultrasound Machines

We proudly operate industry-leading equipment to secure unmatched diagnostic precision.

  • GE Voluson Series: Delivers extraordinary 3D/4D fetal imaging clarity.
  • Philips EPIQ Series: Offers advanced Doppler technology to analyze microscopic fetal blood flows.
  • Samsung HERA Series: Enhances early fetal anatomy assessment through intuitive processing.
  • Canon Aplio Series: Excels in high-resolution imaging for complex obstetric cases.

Why Expectant Mothers Choose Henotic Diagnostics

We understand that maternal reassurance stands above all else. Therefore, our expert team designs an environment of absolute care and scientific excellence.

  • Expert Radiologists: Our FMF-certified specialists bring decades of fetal medicine experience.
  • Fast Report Turn-Around: We generate and verify all reports within 24 hours, often offering same-day delivery.
  • Instant Digital Access: You receive secure WhatsApp reporting and high-quality digital image availability instantly.
  • Maternal Comfort: We guarantee absolute privacy in our modern, hygienic scanning suites.
  • Quick Appointments: Our online, WhatsApp, and phone booking processes ensure zero waiting times.

Ready to secure your baby’s health? Please contact our clinic today to schedule your essential wellness checkup.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is an NT Scan?

An NT Scan (Nuchal Translucency Scan) is a specialized ultrasound performed during early pregnancy to measure the fluid-filled space at the back of the baby’s neck and assess the risk of chromosomal abnormalities and certain birth defects.

When should an NT Scan be performed?

An NT Scan is typically performed between 11 weeks and 13 weeks 6 days of pregnancy, when the fetal crown-rump length falls within the recommended range.

What is the price of an NT Scan?

The cost varies depending on the type of scan, technology used, and reporting requirements. Contact the diagnostic center for the latest pricing and offers.

Is fasting required for an NT Scan?

No. Fasting is generally not required for an NT Scan.

How do you prepare for an NT Scan?

Wear comfortable clothing, carry previous pregnancy reports, and follow any hydration instructions provided by the diagnostic center. Some patients may be advised to have a moderately filled bladder.

What is the procedure for an NT Scan?

The scan is performed using ultrasound over the abdomen, and in some cases a transvaginal approach may be required for better visualization. The sonographer measures the nuchal translucency and evaluates early fetal anatomy. The procedure usually takes 20–40 minutes.

Is NT Scan safe?

Yes. NT Scan uses ultrasound technology and does not involve radiation, making it safe for both mother and baby when performed by qualified professionals.

Can NT Scan diagnose Down Syndrome?

NT Scan does not diagnose Down Syndrome but helps assess the risk. It is often combined with blood tests such as the Dual Marker Test for more accurate screening.

What abnormalities can NT Scan detect?

NT Scan may help identify increased risk for chromosomal abnormalities, congenital heart defects, and certain structural abnormalities during the first trimester.

What happens after an NT Scan?

The findings are reviewed by a radiologist or fetal medicine specialist, and a detailed report is provided. Further testing may be recommended if any abnormalities or increased risks are identified.

spine-mri.content:
🏥 Advanced Spine MRI in Navi Mumbai

First, if you suffer from severe back pain, a Spine MRI in Navi Mumbai offers the most accurate diagnosis available today. A magnetic resonance imaging test gives your doctor incredibly detailed views of your spinal cord. Furthermore, our clinical team conducts this non-invasive procedure completely free of ionizing radiation. Consequently, you safely receive clear pictures of your vertebrae, discs, and surrounding tissues.

At Henotic Diagnostics, we utilize advanced scanning technology to deliver superior diagnostic results. Therefore, our expert radiologists provide precise reports to guide your medical treatment and recovery.

🎯 Why Do Doctors Recommend Spinal Imaging?

Most importantly, physicians suggest this specific MRI scan to identify the exact cause of back discomfort. For example, if you experience radiating sciatica or limb numbness, this test reveals nerve compression clearly. Additionally, doctors rely on it to detect slipped discs, spinal infections, and dangerous tumors early.

Meanwhile, if you recently suffered a sports injury or fall, the scan highlights hidden fractures and tissue trauma. As a result, your healthcare provider can plan an effective treatment or surgical intervention safely. To learn more about neurological imaging safety, you can visit RadiologyInfo.

🦠 Common Conditions Diagnosed Through This Test

Specifically, our high-resolution scans help specialists pinpoint various complex neurological and orthopedic conditions. Therefore, early detection significantly improves your chances of a full recovery.

  • Herniated Discs: First, we identify bulging discs that press against your sensitive spinal nerves.
  • Spinal Stenosis: Furthermore, we detect the narrowing of your spinal canal, which causes severe lower body pain.
  • Degenerative Disc Disease: Similarly, our technology tracks age-related wear and tear in your vertebrae.
  • Multiple Sclerosis (MS): Moreover, we locate demyelinating lesions along your spinal cord to support an MS diagnosis.

🩻 Types of Spine MRI Scans We Offer

We provide comprehensive evaluations for every single section of your back. Specifically, our technicians customize each test to target your unique physical symptoms.

Cervical and Dorsal Spine Evaluations

First, a cervical scan focuses entirely on your neck (C1-C7). Generally, doctors request this to investigate neck stiffness, headaches, or arm weakness. Similarly, a dorsal or thoracic scan examines your mid-back region. Consequently, this helps diagnose thoracic disc disease or mid-back trauma efficiently.

Lumbar, Sacral, and Whole Spine Scans

On the other hand, a lumbar scan investigates your lower back thoroughly. Therefore, it effectively pinpoints the source of leg numbness or a lower slipped disc. Alternatively, a sacral scan looks directly at your tailbone and pelvic nerves.

Finally, if you need a complete overview, we perform a comprehensive whole spine screening. In addition, you can combine this imaging with a CT scan or a specialized blood test for complete health mapping.

🔬 Advanced Technology and Imaging Sequences

To ensure maximum clarity, our modern equipment uses specialized 3.0T technology. First, T1 and T2 weighted imaging provide exceptional anatomical detail. Furthermore, they highlight spinal fluid and hidden inflammation perfectly.

Additionally, our STIR sequence detects bone marrow abnormalities and early microscopic infections. Moreover, we administer safe gadolinium contrast when we need to visualize complex tumors or post-surgical scarring. Thus, we achieve the absolute highest standard of diagnostic accuracy. You can read more about MRI contrast safety at the Mayo Clinic.

  5. Expert Interpretation: Finally, our highly trained radiologists analyze your images to create a comprehensive diagnostic report.

📋 Preparation Guidelines for Your Visit

Preparing for your imaging appointment is incredibly simple. Specifically, you should carry your doctor’s original prescription and any previous medical reports. Furthermore, you must inform our clinical staff about pregnancy or severe claustrophobia.

In most routine cases, you do not need to fast before a standard test. However, if your doctor specifically orders a contrast injection, we recommend fasting for 4 to 6 hours. As a result, you minimize any risk of mild nausea during the procedure.

mri-spine.title: MRI-SPINE
mri-spine.content:
What is an MRI Spine Scan?

An MRI Spine Scan (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) is the most advanced, non-invasive diagnostic tool available for evaluating the spinal cord, vertebrae, and surrounding tissues. Specifically, this procedure utilizes a powerful magnetic field and radiofrequency pulses to generate exceptionally detailed, high-resolution 3D images of your spinal anatomy. Consequently, our expert radiologists can pinpoint the exact cause of back pain, nerve compression, or mobility issues, enabling precise and effective treatment planning.

The Medical Science Behind Spinal Magnetic Resonance Imaging

Unlike traditional X-rays or CT scans, which primarily show bone structure and use ionizing radiation, an MRI scan provides unparalleled contrast resolution for soft tissues—completely avoiding harmful radiation. Furthermore, it allows doctors to clearly visualize intervertebral discs, spinal nerves, the spinal cord itself, and surrounding ligaments. Thus, it remains the absolute gold standard for diagnosing complex spinal pathologies, from disc herniations to spinal tumors.

Comprehensive MRI Spine Scan Types

We offer specialized imaging protocols tailored to evaluate specific anatomical regions of your vertebral column with diagnostic excellence.

  • Cervical Spine MRI: Focuses on the neck region. It is critical for diagnosing neck pain, arm numbness, cervical spondylosis, and whiplash injuries.
  • Dorsal (Thoracic) Spine MRI: Evaluates the middle back. This scan helps detect spinal fractures, tumors, or nerve compression affecting the chest and torso.
  • Lumbar Spine MRI: Scans the lower back. It is the most frequently requested spinal MRI, used to diagnose sciatica, slipped or bulging discs, lower back pain, and leg numbness.
  • Whole Spine MRI (Screening): A comprehensive evaluation of the entire spinal column from the neck down to the tailbone. It is incredibly useful for evaluating systemic spinal diseases, widespread pain, or metastatic cancer screening.

Transparent Pricing and Scan Packages

We firmly believe that life-saving diagnostics should remain accessible. Thus, we structure our pricing to deliver premium medical technology without hidden fees.

Patient Safety Guidelines and Prerequisites

Because the MRI scanner utilizes a superconducting magnet, patient safety remains our absolute highest priority. Therefore, you must follow these strict guidelines:

  • Metal Clearance: You must remove all jewelry, watches, hairpins, hearing aids, and metallic clothing zippers before entering the scan room.
  • Absolute Contraindications: Inform our staff immediately if you have a cardiac pacemaker, cochlear implants, older aneurysm clips, or metallic foreign bodies in your eyes.

What is 3D Mammography (Digital Breast Tomosynthesis)?

If you want the most accurate breast cancer screening available today, 3D Mammography, medically known as Digital Breast Tomosynthesis (DBT), represents a monumental leap in diagnostic imaging. Specifically, our advanced technology captures multiple low-dose X-ray image slices from various angles in a sweeping arc over the breast. Consequently, a high-powered computer reconstructs these slices into a highly detailed, one-millimeter-thick 3D model of your breast tissue.

Furthermore, this technology eliminates the issue of overlapping tissue shadows, which frequently hide small tumors in traditional 2D scans. As a result, our radiologists can examine your breast tissue layer by layer, much like flipping through the pages of a book. Therefore, 3D Mammography significantly increases early cancer detection rates while drastically reducing false alarms.

The Scientific Benefits for Diagnosis and Treatment

Prioritizing advanced breast imaging transforms patient outcomes. Therefore, our medical team highly recommends 3D Mammography for several critical reasons:

  • Unmatched Detection: It detects up to 40% more invasive breast cancers than standard 2D imaging.
  • Ideal for Dense Breasts: Dense breast tissue appears white on an X-ray, exactly like cancer does. Thus, 3D imaging separates these overlapping structures, providing absolute clarity.
  • Fewer Callbacks: Because the imagery is so precise, it reduces false-positive rates by up to 15%. Consequently, you experience less anxiety and avoid unnecessary additional testing.
  • Precise Surgical Planning: If an abnormality is found, the 3D mapping allows oncologists to pinpoint the exact size, shape, and location of the tumor for optimal treatment planning.

Types of 3D Mammography Scans

We provide comprehensive imaging protocols tailored to your specific clinical symptoms and physician referrals.

  • Screening 3D Mammography: We perform this routine preventative checkup for asymptomatic women. Specifically, it aims to catch microscopic calcifications long before a physical lump forms.
  • Diagnostic 3D Mammography: We utilize this targeted approach if you currently experience symptoms like a breast lump, skin dimpling, or nipple discharge. This requires additional, highly focused image angles.
  • Synthesized 2D from 3D Data: Our latest software can automatically generate a standard 2D image directly from the 3D data. Therefore, you receive both views without any extra radiation exposure.

We firmly believe that life-saving diagnostic technology must remain accessible. Please review our highly competitive pricing structure.

Pre-Scan Guidelines & Prerequisites

Proper preparation ensures we capture pristine images. Therefore, please carefully follow our clinical checklist prior to your appointment.

  • Deodorant Restriction: You must completely avoid deodorants, antiperspirants, talcum powder, and lotions on your chest and underarms. Specifically, these products contain metallic particles that mimic microcalcifications on the X-ray.
  • Clothing Choice: Wear a comfortable, two-piece outfit (shirt and pants/skirt). You will only need to undress from the waist up.
  • Cycle Timing: Schedule your scan approximately one week after your menstrual cycle ends, as breast tissue is least tender during this period.
  • Clearance Reports: Always bring your previous mammograms, breast ultrasounds, or biopsy reports to allow our radiologists to compare historical tissue changes.

Fasting and Calcium Medication Conditions

Routine 3D Mammography does not require any fasting. You may eat your meals and drink water exactly as you normally would. However, there is one strict medication rule: You must stop taking calcium supplements 24 hours before your scan. Consequently, undissolved calcium circulating in your bloodstream can occasionally appear as breast calcifications on the scan, creating a false diagnostic alarm.

The Procedure: Step-by-Step Guide

Our certified female technologists perform the 3D Mammography process with profound respect for your dignity and physical comfort.

  1. Check-In & Change: First, our staff welcomes you. Subsequently, you will change into a soft medical gown in a private, secure dressing area.
  2. Expert Positioning: Our female technologist carefully positions your breast on the imaging detector plate. Thus, we ensure all necessary tissue is captured.
  3. Gentle Compression: The machine applies gentle pressure to flatten the breast. While 3D systems still require compression to lower the radiation dose and prevent motion blur, the compression time is typically shorter and the curved paddles are much more comfortable.
  4. The Arc Scan: The X-ray tube moves in a smooth arc above your breast, capturing multiple images in just a few seconds while you briefly hold your breath.
  5. Instant Quality Review: The technologist immediately reviews the digital slices on her monitor to confirm optimal image quality before you leave.

Advanced Machines and Expert Radiologists

At Henotic Diagnostics, we operate state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment. For example, our advanced Hologic Dimensions and GE Senographe Pristina units provide unparalleled high-resolution 3D imaging while utilizing incredibly low radiation doses.

Moreover, our board-certified radiologists possess decades of specialized experience in breast imaging. They meticulously analyze your 3D slices to accurately assign a BI-RADS score, ensuring your primary physician receives exact, actionable data.

Why Choose Henotic Diagnostics?

An MRI Ankle scan is a non-invasive diagnostic technique that utilizes a remarkably powerful magnetic field, radiofrequency pulses, and highly specific computer software. Consequently, this state-of-the-art system generates detailed multiplanar images across axial, coronal, and sagittal views.

Furthermore, unlike routine standard X-rays, magnetic resonance imaging provides exceptional soft tissue visualization without introducing ionized radiation risks. 02 Anatomy of the Ankle Visualized via MRI

The scan perfectly traces the cortical bone borders of the distal tibia and fibula. Additionally, it accurately screens the talus, calcaneus, navicular, and adjacent cuboid components for micro-fractures.

The software detects complete ATFL or CFL disruption and acute calcaneal tendon avulsions. Additionally, it identifies subtle stress fractures and bone bruises that remain fully obscured on analog films.

🦴 Chronic Joint Degeneration

It traces progressive osteoarthritis, extensive synovitis, and deep joint effusions. Meanwhile, radiologists use it to confidently locate localized osteochondral lesions of the superior talar dome.

🛡️ Inflammatory & Mass Formations

The scanner isolates deep ganglion cysts, plantar fasciitis, and chronic tenosynovitis. In addition, it confirms aggressive bone infections like osteomyelitis or localized tissue abscesses.

⚡ Neurological Compression

It outlines tarsal tunnel syndrome by tracking nerve entrapment along the medial reticulating pathways. As a result, neurological specialists obtain definitive confirmation before structural mapping.

MRI Protocol Comparison: With vs. Without Contrast

🔹 Non-Contrast MRI Scan

This approach represents the standard imaging sequence utilizing raw structural magnetic fields. Specifically, it accurately screens over 90% of routine orthopedic injuries.

Best for Sprains, Tears, & Fractures

Technologists inject an intravenous gadolinium element to heighten soft tissue visibility. Consequently, hyper-vascularized tracking exposes deep infectious borders and tumoral margins.

Required for Tumors, Infections, & Post-Op Exams
⚠️

🚨 Urgent Clinical Indications & Red Flags

If you develop severe structural trauma accompanied by any of the clinical manifestations listed below, please consult an orthopedic consultant immediately. Delaying diagnostic mapping risks long-term mechanical instability:

✕ Inability to bear weight after a popping sensation
✕ Rapidly progressive skin discoloration with high fever
✕ Total numbness spreading along the plantar fascia
✕ Continuous non-resolving nocturnal bone pain

Technical MRI Sequences Utilized By Our Technologists

Our imaging sequences adhere to global neuroimaging criteria. Therefore, the specialized scans produce high-contrast, repeatable data matrices.

T1-Weighted (T1W) Perfectly traces bone contours and tracks microvascular fatty tissue modifications.
T2-Weighted (T2W) Accurately captures localized fluid storage, joint effusions, and muscle tears.
Proton Density (PD) The ultimate clinical profile for measuring internal joint cartilage decay.
STIR / Fat Saturation Suppresses broad background fat signals to emphasize active bone marrow edema.

04 Preparation & Scanning Protocols

01. Before Arrival

Wear metallic-free clothing if possible. In addition, patients must communicate the presence of internal pacemakers, deep cardiac stents, or cochlear implants prior to scheduling.

02. Inside the Suite

Our team places a specialized surface extremity coil comfortably over your ankle joint. Subsequently, you must remain completely still to avoid motion artifacts during the 20-minute scan.

03. Post-Scan Actions

You can immediately resume all normal physical activities. Meanwhile, if you received a contrast injection, we recommend increasing your daily hydration to support natural elimination.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does a normal ankle MRI scan mean?

A normal result indicates that all structural bone borders, ligament bands, cartilaginous layers, and tracking tendons are intact, showing no signs of tear, inflammation, or bone marrow edema.

Can an MRI scan easily detect nerve damage along my lower foot?

Yes, high-resolution multiplanar imaging sequences clearly visualize nerve entrapment zones, deep neuromas, and conditions like tarsal tunnel syndrome.

While a prescription helps our radiologists prioritize specific sequences, we also accept self-referrals for patients seeking proactive diagnostic confirmation.

We process and deliver comprehensive, cross-verified structural reports within 24 hours of scan completion.

Scientific Evidence & Clinical Accuracy

According to recent clinical evaluations published by organizations such as the National Institutes of Health (NIH), magnetic resonance profiling exhibits a diagnostic sensitivity above 95% for acute ligamentous trauma. Consequently, it remains the diagnostic gold standard for evaluating complex sports injuries and joint pathologies globally.

pelvis-mri.content:
Comprehensive Pelvis MRI Scan in Navi Mumbai

A Pelvis MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) is a highly advanced, non-invasive diagnostic tool that uses a powerful magnetic field and radiofrequency waves to generate highly detailed, cross-sectional 3D images of the structures inside your pelvic region. This includes the reproductive organs, bladder, rectum, lymph nodes, lower intestines, and the surrounding pelvic bones and musculature. At Henotic Diagnostics, our expert neuroradiologists utilize state-of-the-art MRI technology to detect and diagnose a wide array of pelvic abnormalities with unparalleled scientific accuracy, ensuring you receive the best possible clinical outcomes.

The Medical Science Behind Pelvic Magnetic Resonance Imaging

Unlike CT scans or X-rays, a pelvic scan involves zero ionizing radiation, making it extremely safe. According to medical definitions maintained by the Wikipedia Medical Registry, magnetic resonance provides exceptional contrast resolution for soft tissues, which is vital in the pelvic cavity. By utilizing specialized imaging modalities described by the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), such as T1-weighted, T2-weighted, STIR, and DWI (Diffusion-Weighted Imaging), radiologists can accurately differentiate between benign cysts, malignant tumors, active inflammation, and normal tissue architecture. It remains the absolute gold standard for staging gynecological and urological cancers, evaluating severe pelvic pain, and planning complex surgeries.

Types of Pelvis MRI Scans Offered

Because the pelvic region is highly complex, we offer targeted protocols tailored to your specific symptoms and medical requirements:

  • Pelvis MRI (Plain): A standard evaluation of the pelvic organs, bones, and soft tissues to investigate general pelvic pain, congenital abnormalities, or muscular issues.
  • Pelvis MRI with Contrast: Involves the injection of a Gadolinium-based contrast dye to vividly highlight increased blood flow, which is crucial for identifying tumors, infections, and mapping cancer spread.
  • Multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) Prostate: A highly specialized scan for men that combines different imaging techniques to detect and stage prostate cancer without invasive procedures.
  • MRI Perianal Region: Specifically designed to evaluate perianal fistulas, abscesses, and inflammatory bowel diseases (like Crohn’s disease) with extreme precision.
  • 3-Body Parts / Whole Body Pelvis Screening: Combines pelvic imaging with abdominal or a Whole Spine MRI Scan for a comprehensive assessment of metastatic disease or widespread systemic conditions.

Benefits for Diagnosis and Treatment Planning

A Pelvis MRI provides critical benefits for both patients and referring physicians. It enables accurate staging of prostate, cervical, and uterine cancers, determining the exact size and spread of the tumor. For benign conditions, it reliably diagnoses endometriosis, uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, and sports-related pelvic floor injuries. This precise anatomical mapping directly influences treatment planning—helping surgeons decide between conservative management, minimally invasive laparoscopy, or major surgery. If neurological origins are suspected alongside pelvic symptoms, physicians often request a concurrent Brain MRI Scan to rule out systemic nervous system involvement.

A recent Serum Creatinine Blood Test (done within 30 days) is mandatory to verify safe kidney filtration metrics before contrast administration.

What is a Pelvis MRI?

A Pelvis MRI is an advanced, radiation-free imaging test that uses magnetic fields to produce highly detailed pictures of the organs, bones, and tissues in the pelvic region, including the reproductive organs, bladder, and lower bowel.

What is 3-Body Parts Pelvis MRI & Whole Body Pelvis MRI?

These are comprehensive screening packages. A 3-Body Part MRI typically includes the abdomen, pelvis, and a segment of the spine. A Whole Body MRI scans from head to toe, heavily focusing on the pelvic region for metastasis or systemic disease screening.

You must remove all metallic objects, jewelry, and clothing with zippers. Bring your doctor’s prescription, previous scan reports, and a recent Serum Creatinine report if contrast is required. Inform the technician of any medical implants.

  • Excessive thirst
  • Frequent urination
  • Fatigue
  • Low libido
  • Erectile dysfunction
  • Dizziness
  • Unexplained endocrine abnormalities

MRI Pituitary Brain with Contrast

Contrast-enhanced MRI significantly improves visualization of pituitary lesions by highlighting differences in tissue vascularity and enhancement patterns. Dynamic contrast imaging is particularly valuable for detecting pituitary microadenomas that may otherwise remain undetected.

  • Microadenomas
  • Macroadenomas
  • Pituitary recurrence
  • Postoperative evaluation
  • Cavernous sinus invasion
  • Pituitary stalk lesions
  • Inflammatory disorders
  • Vascular abnormalities

Advantages of MRI Pituitary Brain

  • Excellent soft tissue contrast
  • No ionizing radiation
  • High-resolution multiplanar imaging
  • Detection of very small tumors
  • Excellent visualization of optic pathways
  • Superior evaluation of endocrine anatomy
  • Dynamic contrast assessment
  • Comprehensive postoperative evaluation
  • Safe for repeated follow-up examinations
  • Accurate treatment planning

Preparation for MRI Pituitary Brain

  • Continue medications unless instructed otherwise.
  • Inform staff about implanted medical devices.
  • Remove all metallic objects.
  • Inform the MRI team if pregnant.
  • Discuss previous contrast allergies.
  • Fasting may be required before contrast studies.
  • Bring previous imaging for comparison if available.

What Happens During the MRI Examination?

  1. Patient positioning on the MRI table.
  2. Placement of a dedicated head coil.
  3. Acquisition of high-resolution imaging sequences.
  4. Dynamic pituitary imaging if required.
  5. Contrast injection when clinically indicated.
  6. Additional post-contrast imaging.
  7. Image review by an experienced radiologist.

The examination generally takes between 30 and 60 minutes depending on the imaging protocol and whether contrast enhancement is performed.

What Do Radiologists Evaluate?

  • Pituitary gland size
  • Signal intensity
  • Contrast enhancement
  • Microadenomas
  • Macroadenomas
  • Pituitary stalk abnormalities
  • Optic chiasm compression
  • Cavernous sinus invasion
  • Suprasellar extension
  • Cystic lesions
  • Hemorrhage
  • Adjacent brain abnormalities

Clinical Applications

  • Endocrinology
  • Neurosurgery
  • Neurology
  • Neuro-oncology
  • Ophthalmology
  • Radiation therapy planning
  • Treatment monitoring
  • Long-term surveillance
  • Postoperative assessment
  • Pediatric endocrine disorders

Frequently Asked Questions

Is MRI Pituitary Brain painful?

No. The examination is completely non-invasive and painless.

Does MRI use radiation?

No. MRI uses powerful magnetic fields and radiofrequency waves instead of ionizing radiation.

Can MRI detect very small pituitary tumors?

Yes. Dedicated pituitary MRI protocols can identify lesions measuring only a few millimeters.

Is contrast always required?

Not always. However, contrast significantly improves detection of pituitary microadenomas and assessment of many pituitary disorders.

Can MRI evaluate visual symptoms?

Yes. MRI clearly demonstrates the optic nerves, optic chiasm, and surrounding structures that may be affected by pituitary enlargement.

Why is MRI preferred over CT for pituitary imaging?

MRI offers superior soft tissue contrast, higher spatial resolution, multiplanar imaging capability, and improved detection of pituitary abnormalities compared with CT.

Why MRI Pituitary Brain is the Preferred Imaging Technique

MRI Pituitary Brain remains the imaging modality of choice for evaluating pituitary gland disorders because it provides exceptional visualization of endocrine anatomy, accurately detects tumors of all sizes, assesses surrounding neurological structures, guides surgical planning, evaluates treatment response, and supports long-term patient care without exposing patients to ionizing radiation. Its high diagnostic accuracy makes it indispensable in modern endocrine and neurological imaging.

mri-mrcp.title: Mri Mrcp
mri-mrcp.content:
🩻 MRI MRCP Scan in Mumbai & Navi Mumbai

Has your doctor advised you to get an MRI MRCP in Mumbai or Navi Mumbai? We understand that digestive health issues require quick and precise answers. Therefore, our team at Henotic Diagnostics provides highly accurate imaging to help your doctors find the exact cause of your discomfort. Specifically, an MRI MRCP (Magnetic Resonance Cholangiopancreatography) uses a powerful magnetic field and radio waves to create incredibly detailed pictures of your liver, gallbladder, bile ducts, and pancreas. Consequently, it safely detects blockages and stones without using any harmful radiation or invasive tools.

🩺 What is an MRI MRCP?

This scan focuses strictly on your biliary and pancreatic systems. According to experts at RadiologyInfo.org, this non-invasive test replaces older, uncomfortable procedures like ERCP for initial diagnosis. For example, our expert radiologists use it to clearly map the tubes that carry bile and digestive enzymes. As a result, gastroenterologists can easily spot gallstones lodged in tight ducts. If your doctor wants to look at other surrounding organs, you might also need a general Abdominal MRI Scan.

👨‍⚕️ Why Gastroenterologists Request This Scan

Doctors heavily rely on this imaging technique because it provides crystal-clear details of soft tissues and fluids. Furthermore, many Mayo Clinic specialists recommend it to evaluate unexplained abdominal pain safely. Specifically, your physician might request this test to investigate the following issues:

  • 🪨 Gallstones: Finding stones trapped inside the gallbladder or bile ducts.
  • 🔥 Pancreatitis: Diagnosing acute or chronic inflammation of the pancreas.
  • 🟡 Unexplained Jaundice: Finding the root cause of yellowing skin and eyes.
  • 🦠 Infections & Strictures: Checking for narrowed ducts or severe bile duct infections.
  • 🔬 Tumors & Cysts: Identifying benign growths or early-stage cancers in the biliary system.

💳 Transparent MRI MRCP Price List

We firmly believe that advanced diagnostic care should be transparent and affordable. Moreover, we never surprise our patients with hidden charges. Here is our simple, two-row pricing table for MRCP imaging.

Diagnostic Service Price (₹) Clinical Inclusions
MRI MRCP (Plain) 9,500 Detailed Biliary Scan + Digital WhatsApp Report
MRI MRCP with Abdomen Contrast 12,500 Includes Gadolinium Dye + Full Liver Evaluation

⏱️ How to Prepare and Strict Fasting Rules

To capture accurate images of your digestive system, you must follow our preparation rules carefully. First, you must remove all metal objects, including belts, coins, and jewelry. Second, you must inform our team if you have a cardiac pacemaker, as certain implants restrict you from entering the MRI scanner room.

💧 Crucial Fasting Instructions

Unlike other scans, an MRI MRCP strictly requires fasting. You must consume absolutely no solid food or liquids (except small sips of water) for 4 to 6 hours before your test. Fasting allows your gallbladder to fill with fluid, which makes it highly visible on the scan. Additionally, if your doctor orders a contrast dye scan, you must provide a recent Serum Creatinine Blood Test so we can safely verify your kidney function.

⚙️ Step-by-Step Procedure Guide

We prioritize your comfort while obtaining the best possible medical images. Here is exactly what happens during your visit:

  1. 👕 Preparation: You will change into a comfortable, metal-free hospital gown.
  2. 🧲 Positioning: You will lie flat on your back on the scanner bed. We will place a special imaging coil gently over your stomach area.
  3. 🎧 The Scan: The bed glides into the well-lit MRI tunnel. Because the machine produces loud knocking sounds, we supply you with earplugs or music headphones.
  4. 🫁 Breath-Holding: This is the most important step. Our technologist will ask you to hold your breath for 10 to 15 seconds repeatedly. Doing so prevents your stomach movements from blurring the pictures.

Generally, a complete MRCP test takes about 30 to 45 minutes.

📱 Fast Reports & Dedicated Patient Care

We know that waiting for test results causes unnecessary worry. Therefore, we ensure rapid report delivery. We print your physical high-resolution films within just 20 minutes of completing your scan. Furthermore, our senior radiologists send the final digital PDF report directly to your WhatsApp on the exact same day. If you need urgent assistance, you can easily contact our booking desk to schedule your appointment.

🌟 Patient Feedback & Testimonials

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
“I was suffering from severe jaundice, and my doctor urgently requested an MRCP. The team at Henotic Diagnostics in Navi Mumbai accommodated me immediately. They explained the breath-holding steps perfectly, and I got my reports on WhatsApp the same evening.”
— Snehal P., Navi Mumbai

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
“Very clean center and professional staff. I booked an MRCP scan to check for gallstones. The fasting instructions were clear, the pricing was honest with no hidden fees, and the 3.0T machine was very comfortable.”
— Rohan M., Mumbai

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is an MRI MRCP? ▼

It is a non-invasive imaging test that uses strong magnets to create highly detailed pictures of your liver, gallbladder, bile ducts, and pancreas to check for blockages or diseases.

Do I need to fast for an MRCP scan? ▼

Yes, fasting is absolutely mandatory. You must stop eating and drinking (except small sips of water) for 4 to 6 hours before the scan so your gallbladder remains full and clearly visible.

How much does an MRI MRCP cost in Mumbai? ▼

At Henotic Diagnostics, a standard plain MRCP costs ₹9,500. If your doctor requests an MRCP with comprehensive Abdominal Contrast, the cost is ₹12,500.

Is the MRCP procedure painful? ▼

No, the scan is entirely painless. You simply need to lie still on the scanning bed and hold your breath for short intervals when the technician instructs you.

Can MRCP detect gallstones? ▼

Yes, it is currently one of the most accurate diagnostic tools available for detecting gallstones, especially stones that are deeply trapped inside the bile ducts.
